comment: Dr. LP was a fine teacher and wants to see her students succeed. Do NOT take this class unless you want to definitely be an ethnomusicologist, or super into the study of the most random cultures and music. Moves really quickly in class discussions and notes can be hard to get. Will assign an exam, presentation and paper in one week.
She was very boring, a different teacher would of made the class great
Loved intersession, so much better than sitting at home. Course with lots of field trips, cool guests, and decent work load. Best was trip to rock-n-roll hall of fame in NYC.
I worked hard, but it was worth it. Learned a lot as we were sailing around the world. Didn't like all of the music, but some of it was fun.
ANNOYING!!!!  I took her intro to music class on semester at sea (a study abroad program), it was completely unstimulating, wayyyy too much work, just do your self a favor and dont take her class.

If you don't already know the basics of treble and bass clef don't even bother.  While this is supposed to be an intro class, you had better already have learned this stuff, or you can't possibly do well.

Dr. LP was a pain.  She definitely played favorites.  Overall she was helpful and tried to be fun, but had unreasonably high standards for an intro music class.  I had basic music knowledge before, and still struggled with getting high marks on assignments.  Not bad, but try to find a better class if you can.
Dr. LP is not the easiest, but she makes class interesting.  I had no idea what to expect when I signed up for this class but I had fun

As long as you go to class all but 3 times she drops your lowest quiz. Somewhat easy grader. Don't bother taking the class if you have no experience in learning music. You should be able to read music before you take it. A friend in the class got constant D's, and he plays guitar/bass. I have played piano for 14 years and got an A-..

Pellegrinelli treats this intro class like an advanced-level class. The workload is heavy and the readings largely boring. Her standards are ridiculously high, particularly for a class most people wanted to take for fun. Instead of being fun, though, it turned into the class I least wanted to attend. Pellegrinelli has a lot of room for improvement.
